text:
Sam Kim: FYI I'm seeing a slow, steady increase in ECC counts on a subset of GPUs in rack-13 over the last 36h. Not a single spike, more of a drift.
Ana Patel: Which GPUs? serials or indexes?
Sam Kim: a100-54..a100-59 (slot 2-7). Example from `gpu-telemetry` logs: `gpu_id=a100-56 ecc_corrected=124 -> 203 over 24h`
Lee Gomez: hmm that's odd. Thermal graphs show normal average temps but frequent small excursions ~3-5C every 4-6 hours. Power feed shows tiny voltage dips at the same cadence. Could be PDU switching?
Mike R.: infra-bot just alerted: `PDU-snx-13 rebalanced at 2026-03-12T03:02Z` — check changelog?
infra-bot: deploy-log: PDU-snx-13 scheduled handoff at 2026-03-12T03:00Z (maintenance window).
Ana Patel: Correlate timestamps: ECC drift start ~2026-03-11T22:00Z, PDU handoffs started 03/12 03:00Z. Overlap but not exact. Could be weak VRM transients triggered by switching.
Sam Kim: Agreed. Also noticed `xid` events for a100-58 but low frequency. Not a catastrophic GPU failure, more flaky.
Oncall SRE: Capacity impact? How many jobs will this knock if we drain?
Sam Kim: If we drain 6 GPUs in rack-13, we lose ~6% of A100 pool. We have spare nodes in spare_pool-2 that can absorb short-term.
Lee Gomez: Proposed plan: 1) Snapshot affected GPUs / serials, 2) Re-run vendor stress test (memtest + 48h soak) on spare slot, 3) If increases persist, open RMA for the batch, 4) Schedule PDU vendor onsite to validate feed.
Ana Patel: +1. Also create a quick PromQL to detect same pattern across racks: `increase(gpu_ecc_corrected_total[24h]) > 80 and max_over_time(gpu_temp_c[6h]) - min_over_time(gpu_temp_c[6h]) < 8` — picks up drift without big temp swings.
Mike R.: I'll queue a canary drain tonight during low-util window. Will route jobs to spare_pool-2. Notifying customers on slack-private:infra-maint.
Oncall SRE: Please add emergency fallback: if soak test fails on spare, revert drains and throttle batch jobs by 30% to avoid mass retries.
Sam Kim: Logged issue INFRA-7842 with serials and initial telemetry. Tagging vendor contact (evans@vendorco).
Ana Patel: Also let's add a dashboard panel showing ECC drift rate by rack and PDU handoff events overlayed.
Lee Gomez: Quick triage result after first soak (update in ~12h): memtest passed on 56/57 but 58 showed CRC mismatches after 18h. Moving 58 to RMA list.
Sam Kim: Thanks. We'll track: INFRA-7842. Next check-in tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
Mike R.: Noted. If vendor confirms PDU firmware bug, we might need coordinated firmware freeze across racks. I'll ping infra-ops.
Oncall SRE: Closing loop: ensure change runbook updated to mention VRM checks post-PDU handoff.
Sam Kim: Copy.
